events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas. He died six days later on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering a true hip-hop legend today. Tupac's music and message still resonate almost three decades on.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: We remember guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Still influencing guitarists today, Jimi Hendrix was a true innovator. His legacy lives on.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing shot. Still one of the most recognisable album covers ever, and a timeless album to match!

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, born September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Rocker
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years, Chrissie Hynde is a true icon of punk and new wave. Happy 75th!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher, born September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Swagger
angles.copy: Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Liam Gallagher moment or track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the US on September 9, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Timeless
angles.copy: A song that still resonates globally, its message of peace is as powerful as ever. Timeless.

events.title: First iPod Released Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the very first iPod, which became available for purchase on November 10, 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The device that put a thousand songs in your pocket and revolutionised music on the go.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in London in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme tune? Happy James Bond Day!

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon Visionary
angles.copy: A true visionary whose music and message continue to inspire generations. Remembering John Lennon today.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic comedian and actor, John Cleese, born October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Cleese Comedy Legend
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a master of British comedy. Happy 87th to the brilliant John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking double album, 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: A sprawling masterpiece that showed The Beatles at their most experimental. What's your favourite track from 'The White Album'?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: We remember the incredible showman and Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Icon
angles.copy: Still the greatest frontman of all time? His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. Remembering Freddie Mercury today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Pivotal
angles.copy: A pivotal album that saw The Beatles evolve into new sonic territory. What are your standout tracks?
